decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is still listed, sits close to the core air-cooling offer, and costs little to keep, so the option stays open while its market value becomes clearer.

Withdrawing the similar condenser C concentrates that segment's demand on B, which still shares resources with the core business at low holding cost, although overlap in the portfolio raises some consolidation risk.
The customized multi-model air cooler line fits the firm's integrated-solution strategy and offers many paths to further investment, so abandoning it makes little sense.
The tube end repair inserts support the lifecycle service and spare parts business at minimal cost, and unlike the dropped liner they still hold option value as repair demand develops.
